Awful servicing attitude
Sep 2023 • Friends
VERY BAD SERVICE ATTITUDE.
DISRESPECTFUL SERVICING ATTITUDE

[ENGLISH BELOW]
I will write this review in both Vietnamese and English, and I hope the owner or manager of the restaurant can read it. If possible, please leave your contact so I can easily contact you and talk more about your review.
I am a returning customer who has eaten at Elbow Room many times before. Then came the pandemic, and due to moving the office, it was not convenient to stop by for a meal.
Today, September 14, around 7-8pm, two friends and I stopped by Elbow Room for dinner, because I really like mixed goat cheese pizza and other types of cheese, as well as chicken liver pate here. The food is delicious, still tastes the same as before (except the bread served with pate has changed from baguette to sandwich).
BUT!!!! VERY UNPROFESSIONAL SERVICE, SOME OF THE CUSTOMERS CHALLENGING CUSTOMERS WITH AN ACCEPTABLE ATTITUDE.
I was really shocked and disappointed with such disrespectful customer service. And it's even more shocking when before, the service people were very cute and dedicated.
If the manager or owner of Elbow Room reads this review, please check the camera, your shift will serve on the evening of September 14, 2023 around 7-9pm, table of 3 people right outside the door. enter.
The girl in my group of friends doesn't drink wine with too much astringency, so she asked the waitress for advice on choosing a bottle of wine that's fruity and has the least astringent, sweetest taste possible. This waitress was very enthusiastic and cheerful, but didn't seem to know much about alcohol, so I told her to ask the other waitresses, or anyone at the bar who was more knowledgeable.
A little while later, a young man came out to introduce us, and I wanted to make sure that the bottle of wine he introduced was suitable for our table's taste, so I asked him when he tried pouring the wine, what if he didn't like the wine or had any problems? Can I change it? The younger brother DEFINITELY said NO AND TOLD YOU NOT TO TRY IT. My brother told me that if you want to try it, you should order a single glass. I was wondering, normally when serving wine in a whole bottle, I pour a little first to taste it. I CONFIRM THAT THAT DOES NOT APPLY AT ELBOW ROOM??!?!??! I say it's very unreasonable, because that is the basic way to serve whole bottled wine, and I HAVE ALSO BEEN SERVED THAT way. But because I didn't want to lose my group's spirit and affect the dinner, I said ok, let's order this bottle, but please give me the manager's contact number to complain about this strange incident, as well as understand clearly. more about this new "law".
Then another guy came out to serve the wine, then poured some for us to taste?!?!? I immediately asked, so if it doesn't suit my taste, or if there is a problem, can I exchange it or how to resolve it? My brother answered me that pouring it for tasting is just a formality, but once you order, you have to take it and you can't change it?!?!?! I couldn't understand her response, so when I added that there was nothing to be gained by trying it, she also argued that she would just do it the normal way. I was so upset, I told her to leave the bottle of wine there, we would serve ourselves, no need for such an attitude. I don't even bother to apologize to the customer.
Luckily the quality of the food is still good.
When paying, the first brother came out to apologize, and I asked him for the manager's contact, but he didn't let me. I told the manager to go abroad, please give me feedback if you have any questions. I said that if you don't let me contact the manager, I will review on social networking platforms about dining and travel in the hope that the manager or restaurant owner can read it.
That's why I wrote this very long review. I am really frustrated by the service attitude of the two boys mentioned above. The arguing and overpaying are not professional at all and do not respect the customer at all. The restaurant was not crowded at all, there was only my table, one table had just finished paying, and about half an hour after we sat down there was a takeaway order. I don't understand why the service was so poor. I was even more shocked because I didn't understand where was the dedication, hospitality, and cuteness in the previous service?
Really, with this type of service, there is no reason for me to return to Elbow Room. I know I'm not a VIP customer of the restaurant, but I'm also an old customer... and after today's event, I will forever no longer be a customer of the restaurant, and have no reason to introduce friends to it. What are you doing here?
If the manager or owner of Elbow Room feels that the service staff's behavior is appropriate, or that my review has a problem, then I have nothing more to say.

[ENGLISH]
Im writing this review in both Vietnamese and English with the hope that an owner or manager of Elbow Room will read this. If you want, kindly leave your contact so I can contact you for further discussion.
I am a returning guest with quite many times of visit. After the pandemic, I changed my office so it’s not so convenient to eat here until today, Sept 14, around 7-8pm, my two friends and I decided to have dinner at Elbow Room coz I love the pate and pizza here really much. Food was good still (well, except the baguette in the pate dish was changed by sandwiches).
HOWEVER!!! A BIG BUT!! THE SERVICING ATTITUDES WERE EXTREMELY DISRESPECTFUL, AND AWFULLY BAD. UNACCEPTABLE!! Waiters didnt respect guests, plus, the guys were always in arguing mood, and trying to prove "Youre wrong Im right"
I was shocked, and much disappointed with that kind of attitude. Where were the friendly and caring services like before?? Why is it un-professional like now???
If you're the Elbow Room's manager or owner reading this long review, please check the camera or your staff during the night shift on Sept 14,2023, table of 3, around 7-9pm, the table right behind the main door.
A girl in my group couldnt drink much, and preferred fruity wine taste so we asked for a recommendation from a waitress. The waitress was friendly but seemed not so sure about her wine knowledge. So i told her she could check with other guys or the one at the bar.
Mins later, a guy reached us with his recommendation. I wanted to make sure it’s right for our taste so I asked him when we tasted and it wasn’t alright or something happened to the wine, could we order others? HE STRONGLY REJECTED AND INSISTED IF THIS WAS THE ORDER, I WASNT ALLOWED TO DO TASTING.
He said if i wanted to do tasting, i could order a glass. Then i wondered to him, normally, if we ordered a bottle of red wine, we were allowed to taste before right? HE INSISTED IT WAS NOT APPLIED AT ELBOW ROOM?!?!?!
I told him it was weird because it was a norm to open the wine bottle, pour a bit for tasting right, and IT WAS WHAT I WAS SERVED AT THE ELBOW ROOM BEFORE. Okay, well, i didnt wanna ruin the mood of the dinner with my friends, so i decided to take the bottle, and then, I asked him to provide the manager/owner's contact later to clarify about the services, and this "new kind of policy".
And then, another guy served us the bottle. So, he poured a bit for TASTING?!??! I asked him what if the taste wasnt right or something happened, could I order others or how to solve?
He answered me that IT WAS JUST A THEORY. ONCE I ORDERED I HAD TO ACCEPT IT WITH NO CHANGE?!??! i cant understand his attitude and the answer. I asked him more, then what the purpose of tasting was. He threw me an answer "It is what i need to do" ??!?!?!! I was so insane. I asked him to stop serving my table. He left with no regrets. Was I wrong???
LUCKILY, the two dishes were delicious still.
When we got the bill, the first guy came to say sorry. I asked him about the manager's/owner's contact one more time but he declined to provide. He said the manager was away in overseas, if I had any feedback, I could tell him. I told him if he didnt provide, ok fine, Id wrote reviews on social media for travel and food so I hope the manager/owner can read them all.
It's the reason why Im writing this really long review. I was so extremely shocked by the attitudes of the two guys. They didnt care about the guests . They were disrespectful, awfully serviced minded, and horribly unfriendly. The bistro wasnt crowded at this time at all, only our table, then another one already left, and about 30mins later after we arrived, one takeaway order. So i got no clues why the waiters served us that bad! where were the good old time of servicing attitude, Elbow Room?
To be honest, with tonight's event, I wont come back to Elbow Room for any reason. I know i am not a VIP guest, but a frequent one.. well, not anymore from now on. Of course, there are no reasons to recommend to my friends at all.
So, if the manager/owner finds what the waiters did right, and my reviews are not valid, I have nothing to say.

COVID concerns
Dec 2021
Six friends entered for a beer on a quiet Thursday evening, and FOUR came back COVID-positive 3 days later. Not the restaurant's fault of course, but when I contacted them just to let them know about what happened, the staff couldn't have cared less or been more unconcerned. There's a decent chance it came from the staff, but there was no concern, questions, reaction, information shared ... nothing. Wasn't looking for an apology or an answer, but a "hey, we're so sorry, none of our staff have tested positive or showed any symptoms" would have been nice.

Safe to say there is VERY little concern over Covid or anything close to a protocol at Elbow Room. If that's something that means anything to you, I'd suggest steering clear. There are much better places in West Hartford Center where the food is better and the drinks are priced the same.

Breakfast visit
Jun 2020
Located downtown, the Elbow Room restaurant is conveniently located at the southern end of HCMC's main tourist district. This is my first trip here, for Saturday morning breakfast so here goes..........

When you first walk in, the first thing you realise is that this restaurant has the dim and cosy ambience of a romantic dinner restaurant, not quite the bright and cheery breakfast place you'd expect. They have separate and lunch/dinner section on the menu and this was clearly pointer out by the friendly server.

I ordered the BLT sandwich while my wife had the Bratwurst, both from the main course section, not the breakfast part, but just because this suited our Saturday morning fancies.

The food took about 10-15 minutes to arrive, not the quickest, but again not the slowest but reasonable waiting time. Food quality was excellent according to my wife who ordered her Bratwurst. I found the bacon in my BLT a little overdone, so it was a little burnt and dry, so not to happy about this.

Portion sizes were not exceptionally large, but adequate for our Asian sized appetites, although larger American appetite sizes may struggle to find satisfaction.

Coffee wise, I had a iced black Vietnamese coffee which was a little watered down, and the coffee wasn't the best quality Vietnam had to offer, so improvements in this would be much appreciated.

Overall, I found this place okay, but only just, although my wife may have given higher ratings than myself. But each to his/her own.
